Note: Fedora 4 POM uses org.fusesource.mvnplugins:maven-graph-plugin:1.4 from http://mvnplugins.fusesource.org/repo/release. This site however (http://www.downforeveryoneorjustme.com/http://mvnplugins.fusesource.org) tells me that the repository is down (currently).
Should the POM better reference version 1.5 of this artifact, which is in Maven Central?
